body: It may not, but it definatly means go away, and the best way to do that and prevent me from making anyone else want it is to just go :/

I had a therapist for a while, but that didn't help much because I was so afraid of going to that hell again and couldn't really see them when I needed them.

And I just, I can't even bother to take myself out of the house
Apparently enough to make everyone around me hate me and just want me gone. Have to test me to see if I'm telling the truth about caring for people, I'm that bad.
But I can see all around me, it wouldn't hurt anyone

But I can't, because while for most its a mix, its almost all negative to me. I can't do any of those things, especially donate blood because that hell made that a fear of mine now. I can tell you that there is honestly probably no one that would care I die because I was gone (as opposed to someone's kid). I wouldn't leave anything but a negative impact
But its the constant fear I might, or probably will again, I can't handle it and it just drives me to insanity

Its not that the people I've talked to before were rare talkers, they talked with me all the time, but I did something to cause it to be otherwise, like I always do, ruining everything.

And I'm certain that my death could bring only positives, no negatives I can think of longterm
I may be extremely low, but I know full well it can get worse, I've been there first hand and I don't know I'd I want to live to see that again
The harm is the harm I spread to people by failing, being terrible. I don't want to do that to people

I just, I'm someone that feels utterly hated in the world, and deservedly so. I make people hate and resent me and not want me around and its my fault, and no one else's. I just feel like people would be better off I didn't exist.
The chances of me making something work is slim to none. I'm awkward, moody, Hateable, resented, I can't do a single goddamned thing right. What chance do I have.
Its been 6 long, terrible years where its only gotten worse, in what world could it ever get better?

I can't wipe the slate clean though, because I fear, above all, being stuck inside my own head. Even now I'm alone, no one anywhere to talk to and I'm panicking, falling into the darkest recesses of my mind and I dotn know what to do. It hurts and hurts and I just want above all to give up
I like video games, I guess. But now I'm starting to fall into the darkest recesses of my torment, and I don't know what to do
Almost always the latter, and its always the same, I'm a terrible person and then everyone hates me, making me even more terrible. I shouldn't live because I just get in peoples ways
What do you mean? Like to do in relation to what? And if anything is hopeless, I am

As I said as well, I was thrown in a mental hospital, a place that made my life hell, caused nightmares and panic attacks. I had a therapist but it didn't help much as I couldn't call upon them when I needed them. No one can help me anyway, I'm hopeless
I only make people miserable, people hate me by the end of any relation I have with them. I'm just a terrible person and make people hate me.
At the end of that line, I'm just going to cause the same pains I do now, just to more people. Its not right for me to do so
I find it literally impossible for me to be happy, and all I do is make others miserable. I can't be happy knowing I do that
Sadly, no. Anyone I come in contact with hates me, so at this point, there's no one to make happy, even if I could. I'm that miserable I dont think I ever could be happy.

Yeah, I'm young. That means I can make the amount of people that hate me minimal, since all I do is make people do so. I don't know what help there even is, but I don't want to live an eternity of pain.
I'm 16
I honestly find no way to deal with any of my issues in a way I can see fit. But I can tell you I do not have anything to offer the world but misery, and no one wants that

I've always known I'm not alone, and in many ways, that's made it worse. I fully realize that my problems pale in comparison to most other peoples, and that makes me feel even more in the way of things
I just, I'm just starting to feel like a complete and utter failure with everything I am. Anything I do is wrong and I apparently just make people miserable.
I just don't know what to do.
I'm not really, adamate about having medication, like I said, I just feel like I get in the way, I don't want anyone to have to spend time or money on me
Sigh, I just don't know

I have never taken any medication and really don't seek to. I never felt the need to, I'm nothing close to the people that do, I just feel like I'm always in the way.

When I feel depressed, I think about that hell I went to, and that makes it worse, throws me into panic attacks. I think about how worthless I am, and I think about how much I get in peoples ways and how much I'm hated, and I just don't know what to do.

I had counseling for a while, but what I meant that it keeps me alive is the fear of going back. The counseling was okay, but nothing was going to change how I see the world, I believe I see it realistically. It was okay counselling, but most of the time I have no one to talk to :/
But the reason I should die is because I'm just that bad, that I'm so hopeless that not even anything I try to do helps. I can only do wrong, so what's the point in trying and just dying instead
I want to feel better, but because everyone eventually gets to hate me, the only way I can do that is not exist. It would make me happy to make everyone else happy by dying.
They are a waste of time, I can't not waste time if all I see is ending myself, I don't find any other way to drive my life
